_comment: Copy this file to n8n/credentials.local.json and fill in the IDs from your own
n8n instance. That copy is ignored by Git so your instance-specific credential
Committed workflow files reference placeholder credential IDs. After running
import-workflows, run the binder to point them at your real credentials:
Find an ID in n8n by opening Credentials and reading it from the browser URL,
Leave a placeholder out of the map entirely if you have not created that
credential yet. The binder skips unmapped placeholders and reports them.
